headline: Sharks’ Marchment fined for roughing Islanders’ Eklund
take: Daily Faceoff reports the NHL fined San Jose's Mason Marchment for roughing the Islanders' Victor Eklund, a play that drew two minor penalties on Monday. Sharks Hockey Digest put the fine at $5,000. It's a small footnote to a useful win: San Jose beat New York in a shootout to snap a five-game winless run. Both teams need any edge they can find. The Sharks have 43% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) on the season and the Islanders 46%, and both are well short of their chances in finishing. Marchment, one goal from 100 for his career, has been playing bigger minutes with Igor Chernyshov hurt; San Jose can't afford him in the box.
